subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this operation-aware delivery resolver and QQBot READY/RESUMED pending-drain behavior as the core fix for setup-only channel shells and queued outbound deliveries?
rationale: The patch addresses a credible P1 message-loss regression, but the remaining choice is compatibility and message-delivery ownership rather than a narrow mechanical defect automation can safely settle.

options.title: Approve After Green Scan
options.body: Accept the resolver split and QQBot reconnect drain, then merge after OpenGrep reruns cleanly or is explicitly waived as infrastructure-only.

options.body: Ask the contributor to keep the QQBot reconnect recovery while deferring shared delivery-resolution semantics to an owner-designed follow-up.

options.title: Pause Shared Semantics
options.body: Leave the PR open until an outbound/channel owner is ready to own cross-channel delivery-resolution behavior.
